name: Deathstalker Faerleia
summary: Deep inside Pyrewood Village, Deathstalker Faerleia works against its leaders. From the town hall, she directs covert strikes against the Pyrewood Council, the puppets Arugal uses to rule the village.

sections.title: Behind Enemy Lines
sections.body: Deathstalker Faerleia works from the upper levels of Pyrewood Village's town hall. As an agent of the Deathstalkers, the Undercity's covert intelligence and assassin branch, she has infiltrated the isolated human enclave in southern Silverpine Forest. The village holds dark secrets, including a curse that transforms its people beneath the night sky. From inside the settlement, Faerleia coordinates operations to disrupt it and calls on Horde operatives to eliminate influential members of the Pyrewood Council.

faq.answer: Faerleia serves in the Deathstalkers, Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's stealth and intelligence division. She has slipped into Pyrewood Village to wage a covert war against its leadership.

faq.q: Where can Deathstalker Faerleia be found?
faq.answer: Faerleia can be found inside Pyrewood Village's town hall, in southern Silverpine Forest just north of the Greymane Wall.
Faerleia directs adventurers in the Pyrewood Ambush, an operation to assassinate the councilmen who govern Pyrewood Village and weaken the enclave's resistance to the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why are the Deathstalkers targeting Pyrewood Village?
faq.answer: Arugal uses the Pyrewood Council as puppets to keep the cursed villagers under his control. Faerleia believes that if the council dies, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master, helping the Forsaken take the town and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how Faerleia uses infiltration and cold calculation to dismantle enemies of the Dark Lady without committing an entire army.
As a Rogue serving the Forsaken, you can look to Faerleia's field craft: she slips into the enemy's seat of power unnoticed and orchestrates ambushes.
